Style title (verbatim): "CYBERCORE"
Footer text (verbatim): "37 / VISUAL DESIGN"
Art direction: A distinctive Y2K cybercore graphic poster, with a sculptural polished-chrome four-point star and thin technical wireframe orbital forms against deep electric cobalt. Compressed metallic techno typography, tiny schematic crosshairs and measured grid fragments. Precise silver reflections and digitally distressed edges. Sharp experimental graphic design, not a neon city or science-fiction movie scene.
Constraints: original artwork; no website, app screen, contact sheet, external brand, device mockup or stock watermark.
